{{Quote|The Supreme Commander never takes the same risks as the common soldiers. I have my duty, they have theirs.|Estosh|<ref name="SWG">''[[Survivor's Quest]]''</ref>}}
The '''Supreme Commander''' was the leader of the [[Vagaari/Legends|Vagaari's]] military forces. The only known Vagaari Supreme Commander was [[Estosh]].
